title: FAQ: Does Stacko work with my ERP?
caption:
"Does Stacko work with my ERP?" Yes.

If you use Odoo, SAP or another system, Stacko can sit on top of it and add the map and AI document capture. If you don't have a system, Stacko can be your full inventory.

Connections are set up for each customer: tell us what you run, and we'll confirm what's possible before any commitment.

Book a meeting to discuss your setup. Link in bio.
